Bank Job Solution.question:
১) Fill in the blank with right option (01-04):
১) Someone who is ____ is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Optimistic - hoping or believing that good things will happen in the future.
Example: She is optimistic about her chances of winning a gold medal.
Opposite - pessimistic.

Bank Job Solution.question: ২) While on a tour, tourists are only given a _______ time at each place of attraction.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
প্রশ্নোক্ত বাক্যের বঙ্গানুবাদঃ ভ্রমনের সময়ে ভ্রমনকারীদের (পর্যটকদের) আকর্ষণীয় জায়গাগুলোতে শুধুমাত্র সীমিত সময়ের জন্য ঘুরতে দেওয়া হয়।
ভ্রমণকালীন সময়ের সীমাবদ্ধতাকে বুঝাতে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ শব্দ হচ্ছে - limited.
এখানে confined হবে না কারণ এখানে কোনো কিছুকে আবদ্ধ (encircled) করা হয় নি এবং particular বা certain হবে না কারণ সময়ের কোনো নির্দিষ্ট পরিমাণ বুঝাচ্ছে না বরং বাক্যের মূল focus হচ্ছে 'সময় সীমিত (limited)' সেদিকে।
Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English এর phrase-টির দিকে লক্ষ করলেও উত্তরের ব্যাপারে পরিষ্কার ধারণা পাওয়া যাবে - limited number/amount/time etc

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩) I just had to _______ the orders of my employer.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Carry out something - to perform or complete a job or activity; to fulfill.
Example: I was elected to carry out a program, the governor said, and I have every intention of carrying it out.
- I just had to carry out the orders of my employer.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪) Many forms of cancer can be cured if _____ early.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
বাক্যে বলা হয়েছে - ক্যান্সার নিরাময় করা যেতে পারে যদি আগে সেটাকে শনাক্ত করা যায়।
যেহেতু বাক্যটি passive form এ আছে, সেক্ষত্রে detect এর past form ‘detected’ হবে এখানে যৌক্তিক উত্তর।
সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে - Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
Source: Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English

Bank Job Solution.question:
৯) Read the following page and answer the questions given below it in the context of the passage. (09-12):
A new atomic clock being developed for navigation satellites will perform better than previous devices. The Clock will use a new microwave cavity design to provide a compact and lightweight package and new electronic techniques to maintain long-term stability. The clock can provide precise navigation information because it is stable to one second in three million years. The differences in the time when signals from four satellites arrive at one location can be used to calculate that position to within a few yards.
৯) It can be inferred from the passage that the new clock will be-
Bank Job Solution.exp: প্যাসেজের “The Clock will use a new microwave cavity design to provide a compact and lightweight package and new electronic techniques to maintain long-term stability.” এই বাক্য থেকে বুঝা যাচ্ছে যে নতুন ঘড়ি দীর্ঘস্থায়ী হবে।

Bank Job Solution.question: ১০) According to the passage signals from how many satellites will be used to calculate a position?
Bank Job Solution.exp: ‘when signals from four satellites arrive at one location can be used to calculate that position’ - এখান থেকে বুঝা যাচ্ছে যে চারটি স্যাটেলাইটের সিগন্যাল ব্যবহার করে অবস্থান নির্ণয় করা যাবে।

Bank Job Solution.question: ১১) What is the primary purpose of the passage?
Bank Job Solution.exp: অনুচ্ছেদটির প্রাথমিক উদ্দেশ্য হচ্ছে navigation satellite এ যে ধরনের atomic clock ব্যবহার করা হবে, তার ব্যাপারে তথ্য প্রদান করা (to provide information).

Bank Job Solution.question: ১২) From the passage, it can be inferred that which of the following characteristics of the clock mentioned will be most impressive?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
অনুচ্ছেদটি পাঠ করে ঘড়ির যেসব বৈশিষ্ট্য দেখা যায় তার মধ্যে সবচেয়ে চমৎকার বৈশিষ্ট্য হচ্ছে এর বিশুদ্ধতা (accuracy).
কারণ এটা সঠিক তথ্য প্রদানের জন্য চারটি স্যাটেলাইটের সহায়তা নিচ্ছে। আটসাট গঠন এবং ওজনে কম হওয়ার বৈশিষ্ট্য তো সাধারণ ঘড়িতেও থাকে, কিন্তু এ ধরনের নির্ভুল তথ্য দেওয়ার জন্যই এ ঘড়িটি অনন্য।

Bank Job Solution.question:

Source: Oxford Dictionary

Bank Job Solution.question: ১৪) ARENA : CONFLICT

Source: Oxford Dictionary

Bank Job Solution.question: ১৫) FANS : BLEACHERS

প্রশ্নটি (Probashi Kallayn Bank Ltd. Post Name: Senior Officer Exam Date: 12.01.2018) - এর ছিলো। অপশনে যেহেতু মিশ্র শব্দ (ফারসি+আরবি) দেওয়া নেই, তাই এখানে প্রধান শব্দ 'কলম' আরবি থেকে আসায় অধিক গ্রহণযোগ্য উত্তর 'আরবি নেওয়া হয়েছে।

Bank Job Solution.question: ১৮) ‘সূর্য দীঘল বাড়ি’ কোন ধরনের রচনা?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
আবু ইসহাক (১৯২৬-২০০৩): ঔপন্যাসিক, কথাসাহিত্যিক। তাঁর উল্লেখযোগ্য গ্রন্থ-

উপন্যাসঃ
- সূর্য দীঘল বাড়ি (একটি সামাজিক উপন্যাস। বিশ্বযুদ্ধ, দুর্ভিক্ষ, সাম্প্রদায়িক দাঙ্গা, দেশভাগ প্রভৃতি পরপর চারটি বড় ঐতিহাসিক ঘটনার পটভূমিতে রচিত হয়েছে সূর্যদীঘল বাড়ী উপন্যাস। জয়গুন এই উপন্যাসের কেন্দ্রীয় চরিত্র। উপন্যাসটি ১৯৫৫ সালে প্রকাশিত এবং এটি তার প্রথম প্রকাশিত উপন্যাস।),
- পদ্মার পলিদ্বীপ (আবু ইসহাক রচিত দ্বিতীয় সামাজিক উপন্যাস। এটি পদ্মার বুকে জেগে উঠা চরে শ্রমজীবী মানুষের সংগ্রাম নিয়ে রচিত একটি উপন্যাস।),
- জাল (তাঁর রচিত গোয়েন্দা উপন্যাস)।

গল্পগ্রন্থঃ হারেম, মহাপতঙ্গ ইত্যাদি।
ছোটগল্পঃ জোঁক।
তাঁর রচিত একমাত্র নাটক - ‘জয়ধ্বনি’।
তাঁর স্মৃতিচারণমূলক রচনা ‘স্মৃতিবিচিত্রা’ প্রকাশিত হয় ২০০১ সালে।

উৎসঃ লাইভ এমসিকিউ লেকচার এবং বাংলাপিডিয়া।

Bank Job Solution.question: ১৯) উষ্ণ শব্দের যুক্তাক্ষরটি কোন কোন বর্ণের সমন্বয়ে গঠিত?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
• ষ্ণ = ষ + ণ, যেমন- কৃষ্ণ, কৃষ্ণচূড়া, তৃষ্ণা, উষ্ণ ইত্যাদি।
• ক্ষ = ক + ষ,
• হ্ম = হ + ম,
• জ্ঞ = জ + ঞ।
উৎসঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ ও নির্মিতি, নবম-দশম শ্রেণি।

Bank Job Solution.question: ২১) মহিমা শব্দের প্রকৃতি ও প্রত্যয় কোনটি ?

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩১) অধর পল্লব কোন সমাসের উদাহরণ।
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- উপমিত কর্মধারয় সমাস: উপমেয় ও উপমান পদের যে সমাস হয়, তাকে উপমিত কর্মধারয় সমাস বলে।
- এই সমাসে সাধারণ ধর্ম উল্লেখ করা থাকে না। অর্থাৎ, উপমান ও উপমিত কর্মধারয়ের মধ্যে যেটিতে সাধারণ ধর্মবাচক পদ থাকবে না, সেটিই উপমিত কর্মধারয় সমাস।
যেমন, 'পুরুষ সিংহের ন্যায় = পুরুষসিংহ'।
এখানে 'পুরুষ'কে 'সিংহ'র সঙ্গে তুলনা করা হয়েছে। অর্থাৎ এখানে 'পুরুষ' উপমেয় আর 'সিংহ' উপমান।
সাধারণ ধর্মের উল্লেখ নেই।
সুতরাং, এটি উপমিত কর্মধারয় সমাস।

যেমনঃ
মুখ চন্দ্রের ন্যায় = মুখচন্দ্র।
কর কমলের ন্যায় = করকমল।
আসন পদ্মের ন্যায় = পদ্মাসন।
অধর পল্লবের ন্যায় = অধরপল্লব

Bank Job Solution.question:
৩৩) Read the following questions carefully and choose the right answer. (33-56):
৩৩) The length of a rectangle is 20% more than its breadth. Find the ratio of the area of the rectangle to that of the square whose side is equal to the breadth of the rectangle.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let the breadth of the rectangle be x
∴ According to question,
Length = 1.20x
∴ Area of rectangle = 1.20x × x = 1.20x2
Area of square = x × x = x2
∴ Required ratio = 1.20x2/x2
= 12/10
= 6/5

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩৪) A tank has two leakages. The first leakage alone can empty the tank in 9 minutes and the second alone would have done it in 6 minutes. If water leaks out at a constant rate, how long does it take both the leakage together to empty the tank?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
In the 1st case,
1/9 part of the tank is emptied in 1 min
In the 2nd case,
1/6 part of the tank is emptied in 1 min
So, together in 1 min, they empties = (1/9 + 1/6) = 5/18 part

Now, 5/18 part is emptied in 1 minute
∴ 1 or, total part is emptied in = 18/5 = 3.6 minutes

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩৫) Worker P is 50% as efficient as worker Q. Worker R does half of the work done by P and Q together. If R alone does the work in 40 days, then P, Q and R together can do the work in -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
As, R takes 40 days to complete the work, (P + Q) will take = 40/2 = 20 Days
R can do 1/40 part of the work in one day and (P + Q) can do 1/20 part of the work in a day.
So, in 1 day (P + Q + R) can do = (1/20 + 1/40) = (3/40) part of the work
∴ Days required to complete 1 or Total work is = 40/3 = 13(1/3) days

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩৬) The sum of the circumference of a circle and the perimeter of a rectangle is 130 cm. The area of the rectangle is 104 cm<sup>2</sup> and the length of the rectangle is 13 cm. What is the area of the circle?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Given, Length of rectangle, L = 13 cm
breadth, B = 104/13 = 8 cm
So, its perimeter = 2(13+8) = 42
ATQ, 2πr = 130 - 42
Or, 2πr = 88
Or, r = 14
∴ Area of the circle = πr2 = 22/7 × 142 = 616 cm2

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩৭) A box is made in the form of a cube. If a second cubical box has inside dimensions three times those of the first box, how many times as much does the second box contain?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
If the second box has each dimension three times that of the first box, then its volume is 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 times.
So, the second box contains 27 times as much the first box.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩৮) If 2 kg of metal, of which 1/3 is zinc and the rest is copper, be mixed with 3 kg of metal, of which 1/4 is zinc and the rest is copper, then what will be the ratio of zinc to copper in the mixture?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Quantity of zinc in the mixture = 2(1/3) + 3(1/4) = 17/12
Quantity of copper in the metal = (3 + 2) - 17/12 = (60 - 17)/12 = 43/12
So, the ratio of Zinc and Copper = 17/12 : 43/12 = 17 : 43

Bank Job Solution.question: ৩৯) One filling pipe P is three times faster than another filling pipe Q, if P can fill tank in 24 hours, then what is the time taken to completely fill the tank if both the pipes are opened together?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Time taken by P = 24 hours
So, Q takes = 24 x 3 = 72 hours
Required time to fill the tank with both pipe = (24 x 72)/(24+72) = 18 hours

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪০) A box contains 4 tennis ball, 6 season and 8 dues balls. 3 balls are randomly drawn from the box. What is the probability that the balls are different?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
There are a total of 18 balls.
∴ Probability of the balls to be different is,
= (4C1 × 6C1 × 8C1)/(18C3)
= (4 × 6 × 8)/(18×17×16 / 6)
= (4 × 6 × 8 × 6)/(18 × 17 × 16)
= 4/17

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪১) On dividing an individual number by 342, we get 47 as remainder. If the same number is divided by 18, what will be the remainder?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Consider the number be 342 + 47 = 389.
Therefore 389 divided by 18 leave remainder 11

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪২) Rahim and Karim donated Tk. 100 each in charity. Karim gives each Tk. 1 more than Rahim and Rahim distributes money to 5 more people than Karim. How many people are there in this charity?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let, Karim donates x taka each.
And, Rahim donates = x+1 taka each
ATQ,
100/x – 100/(x+1) = 5
Or, x2 + x - 20 = 0
Or, x2 + 5x - 4x - 20 = 0
Or, (x-4)(x+5) = 0
So, x = 4; x ≠ -5
∴ Karim donates to = 100/4 = 25 people
Rahim donates to = 100/5 = 20 people
Therefore, number of people in the charity = 20+25 = 45

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪৩) A square is inscribed in a circle of diameter 2a and another square is a circumscribing circle. The difference between the areas of outer and inner squares is -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Area or outer space = 2a x 2a = 4a2
From ABCD rectangle, In ΔBAD,
BD2 = (AD)2 + (AB)2
⇒ (2a)2 = x2 + x2
⇒ 4a2 = 2x2 
⇒ 2a2 = x2 
∴ x = √2a

Area of inner square = √2a × √2a = 2a2 

∴ The difference between the areas of outer and inner squares is = 4a2 - 2a2 = 2a2

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪৪) The income of ‘A’ is 20% higher than that of ‘B’. The income of ‘B’ is 25% less than of ‘C’. What percent less is A’s income from C’s income?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let,
C's income = 100
So, B's income = 100-25 = 75
And,
A's income = 75 + 75×(20/100) = 75+15 = 90
∴ A’s income less from C’s income is = {(100 - 90)/100}×100 = 10%

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪৬) There are n students in a school. If r% among the students are 12 years or younger, which of the following expressions represents the number of students who are older than 12?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
1 জন ছাত্রের মধ্যে 12 কিংবা তার কম বয়সী ছাত্র আছে = r/100
n জন ছাত্রের মধ্যে 12 কিংবা তার কম বয়সী ছাত্র আছে = rn/100
∴ ঐ বিদ্যালয়ে 12 বছরের বেশি ছাত্র আছে = (n - rn/100)
= (100n - rn)/100
= n(100 - r) / 100 জন

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪৭) 125 gallons of a mixture contains 20% water. What amount of additional water should be added such that water content be raised to 25%?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
In the original 125 gallons of mixture, 20% is water.
Hence, no. of gallons of other materials in the mixture: 125 x 80% = 100 gallons
In the new mixture, water makes up 25%, thus 75% is other materials.
As no. of gallons of others is unchanged, 100 gallons = 75% in the new mixture volume.
The total volume of the new mixture is : 100 / 75% = 100/ 0.75 = 133.33 gallons.
∴ Required additional amount of water = 133.3 – 125 = 8.33 = 8(1/3) gallons

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪৮) The sum of squares of two numbers is 80 and the square of difference between the two numbers is 36. Find the product of two numbers
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let, Two numbers x & y
ATQ,
x2 + y2 = 80
And,
(x – y)2 = 36
Or, x2 + y2 – 2xy = 36
Or, 80 – 2xy = 36
Or, 2xy = 44
Or, xy = 22
∴ The product of two numbers is: 22

Bank Job Solution.question: ৪৯) A student loses 1 mark for every wrong answer and scores 2 marks for every correct answer. If he answers all the 60 questions in an exam and scores 39 marks, how many of them were correct?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let us assume that he answered x question correctly. Marks scored by him in x question = 2x
Then, wrong answer would be = 60 – x
Marks lost by him in (60 – x) questions = (60 – x)×1
ATQ,
2x – (60 – x) = 39
Or, 3x = 99
∴ x = 33

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫০) There are two stations of length 162 meters and 120 meter respectively. A train takes 18 seconds to pass first station and 15 seconds to pass another station. Determine the length of the train.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let length of the train be x m
Speed of train,
(x+162) / 18 = (x+120) / 15
∴ x = 90 m

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫১) A man rows a certain distance along the stream and against the stream in 1 hour and 1.5 hours respectively. If the velocity of the current is 3 km/hr, what is the speed of the man in still water?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let the speed of the man in still water = x
Given that, speed of the stream = 3 km/h
So, Speed downstream = (x + 3) km/h
and, Speed upstream = (x – 3) km/h
ATQ,
(x + 3) × 1 = (x - 3) × 1.5
Or, x + 3 = 1.5x – 4.5
Or, 0.5x = 7.5
∴ x = 15

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫২) A milkman pays Tk. 6.40 per liter of milk. He adds water and sells the mixture at Tk. 8 per liter. By doing this, he makes 37.5% profit. Find the proportion of water to milk received by the customer.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Let the quantity of milk purchased be x and quantity of water added be y.
Then, the ratio of water to milk is y : x.
CP = 6.4x
SP = 8(x+y)
Profit per cent = 37.5%
Therefore,
8(x+y) = 6.4x × 1.375
Or, 8x + 8y = 8.8x
Or, 8y = 0.8x
Or, y/x= 0.8/8
∴ y : x = 1 : 10

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫৩) A leading library charges c cents for the first week that a book is loaned and f cents for each day over one week. What is the cost for taking out a book for d days, where d is greater than 7.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
As, d days is greater than 7 days
So, charge for first week is c cents
∴ For (d - 7) days the charge is = f(d - 7) cents
So, total cost = c + f(d - 7)

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫৪) Find the compound interest at the rate of 10% per annum for four years on the principal which in four years at the rate of 4% per annum gives Tk. 1600 as simple interest.
৫৫) A wheel rotates 10 times per minute and moves 20 m during each rotation. How many meters does the wheel move in 1 hour?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Number of rotation in one hour = 10 × 60 = 600
So, Distance moved = (600 × 20) = 12000 m

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫৬) An amount of Tk. 366 is to be divided among P, Q and R in such a manner that Q gets two-third as much as P and R together, and P may get half as much as Q and R together. What is the share of P?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Given,
Q = 2/3(P + R)
Or, 3Q = 2(P + R)
Again,
P = (Q + R)/2
Or, 2P = Q + R
Now,
P + Q + R = 366
Or, P + 2P = 366
Or, 3P = 366
∴ P = 122

Bank Job Solution.question:
৫৭) Study the following questions carefully and answer the questions given below: (57-80):
৫৭) Information on a computer is stored as what?
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- Computers can only work with digital information. Everything that they process must first be turned into a digital signal in one of two states: 'on' or 'off'.
At a basic level a computer processor is a collection of switches which can either be on or off. These switches are known as transistors. The computer processes information by switching transistors on and off automatically.
- Information from input devices must be digitised so the information can be processed.
In order to process information and store it, computers use binary code. Binary is a language composed of just the numbers 1 and 0.

Source: BBC

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫৮) Graphical pictures that represent an object like file, folders etc. are:
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Icon is a small graphical representation of a program or file. When we double-click an icon, the associated file or program will be opened.
- For example, if we were to double-click on the My Computer icon, it would open Windows Explorer.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৫৯) Computer Virus is a _______.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
VIRUS বা Vital Information Resources Under Siege ভাইরাস হল এক ধরনের সফটওয়্যার যা তথ্য-উপাত্তকে আক্রমণ করে এবং যার সংখ্যা বৃদ্ধির ক্ষমতা রয়েছে।
১৯৮০ সালে নিউ হ্যাভেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের অধ্যাপক ফ্রেড কোহেন সর্বপ্রথম এরূপ সফটওয়্যারের নামকরণ VIRUS করেন। স্টোন, ভিয়েনা, সিআইএইচ, ফোল্ডার প্রভৃতি কম্পিউটার ভাইরাসের উদাহরণ।

সূত্রঃ তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি, নবম-দশম শ্রেণী

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬০) Verification of a login name and password is known as
Bank Job Solution.exp:
Authentication is the process of recognizing a user's identity.
Different systems may require different types of credentials to ascertain a user's identity.
- The credential often takes the form of a user id and password, which is a secret and known only to the individual and the system.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬১) When cutting and pasting, cutting section is temporarily stored in -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
The Office Clipboard allows you to copy up to 24 items from Office documents or other programs and paste them into another Office document.
For example, you can copy text from an email message, data from a workbook or datasheet, and a graphic from a presentation, and then paste them all into a document.
By using the Office Clipboard, you can arrange the copied items the way that you want in the document.

You’re not limited to only pasting the last item you copied or cut when you use the Clipboard task pane.
The Clipboard task pane holds many of the last images and text you copied or cut.

Source: www.support.microsoft.com

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬২) The set of instructions that tells the computer what to do is -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- Software, instructions that tell a computer what to do.
The software comprises the entire set of programs, procedures, and routines associated with the operation of a computer system.
The term was coined to differentiate these instructions from hardware - the physical components of a computer system.

Source: Britannica

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬৩) Which one of this also known as read/write memory -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- RAM is known as read/write memory.
- RAM is much faster to read from and write to than the other kinds of storage in a computer, such as the hard disk or removable media.
- RAM is used as a short memory because it is Volatile.
- RAM is called 'volatile' memory by analogy because if the computer loses power, all the data stored in RAM (or other volatile memory) is lost or 'evaporates'.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬৬) A computer on internet is identified by:

IP address, in full Internet Protocol address, Number that uniquely identifies each computer on the Internet.
A computer’s IP address may be permanently assigned or supplied each time that it connects to the Internet by an Internet service provider.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬৭) The basic unit or a worksheet into which you enter data in Excel is called a -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
The basic unit of a worksheet into which you enter data in excel is called a cell.

Enter text or a number in a cell

- Type the numbers or text that you want to enter, and then press ENTER or TAB. To enter data on a new line within a cell, enter a line break by pressing ALT+ENTER.

Source: Microsoft Support

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬৮) Operating systems are the most common type of ______ software.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- An operating system is the most important software that runs on a computer. It manages the computer's memory and processes, as well as all of its software and hardware.
It also allows you to communicate with the computer without knowing how to speak the computer's language. Without an operating system, a computer is useless.
- Operating systems are the most common type of system software.
• Windows 10 is the most popular operating system for desktop and laptop computers.
• Android is the most popular smartphone operating system.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৬৯) The World Trade Organization came into existence in _______.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
বিশ্ব বাণিজ্য সংস্থা (WTO)
WTO এর পূর্ণরূপ World Trade Organization বা বিশ্ব বাণিজ্য সংস্থা। ব্রেটন উডস সম্মেলনের সুপারিশ মোতাবেক ১৯৪৭ সালে General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) গঠিত হয়।
জেনেভাতে GATT গঠনকালে ২৩টি দেশ তা প্রথম অনুমোদন করে এবং ১ জানুয়ারি, ১৯৪৮ সালে GATT চুক্তি কার্যকরের মাধ্যমে এই বৈশ্বিক বানিজ্যিক সংগঠনের কার্যক্রম শুরু হয়। আনুষ্ঠানিক ভাবে GATT প্রতিষ্ঠার তারিখ তাই - ১ জানুয়ারি, ১৯৪৮ সাল।
⤇ WTO - কোন নির্দিষ্ট পণ্যের আমদানি-রপ্তানির ক্ষেত্রে সৃষ্ট সমস্যার ফলে কোন দেশ ক্ষতিগ্রস্থ হলে তার ক্ষতি পোষানোর জন্য ব্যবস্থা গ্রহন করা।
⤇ ১৯৪৭ সাল থেকে ১৯৯৩ সাল পর্যন্ত GATT চুক্তির দুর্বলতা ও সমস্যা সমাধানের জন্য মোট ৮টি রাউন্ড সম্পন্ন হয়। যেমন -
- Kennedy Round (১৯৬৪ - ৬৭),
- Tokyo Round (১৯৭৩ - ৭৯) ইত্যাদি।

এগুলোর মধ্যে সবচেয়ে গুরত্বপূর্ণ ও তাৎপর্যপূর্ণ রাউন্ড হচ্ছে - Uruguay Round (১৯৮৬ - ৯৪)।
১৫ এপ্রিল, ১৯৯৪ সালে উরুগুয়ে রাউন্ডের সমাপ্তির সময়ে GATT চুক্তি সংশোধনের মাধ্যমে নতুন আন্তর্জাতিক বাণিজ্য সংগঠন গঠনের সিদ্ধান্ত হয় এবং যার ফলে ১৯৯৫ সালে জন্ম হয় World Trade Organization (WTO) - এর।

উৎসঃ WTO Website ও Live MCQ Content (Upcoming)।

Bank Job Solution.question: ৭০) Mount Etna is a famous volcano located in __________.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- Mount Etna, Latin Aetna, Sicilian Mongibello, active volcano on the east coast of Sicily, Italy.
The name comes from the Greek Aitne, from aithō, “I burn.”
Mount Etna is the highest active volcano in Europe, its topmost elevation being about 10,900 feet (3,320 metres).

The term sugar bowl of the world was invented to refer to a region of the world with high sugar production.

Bank Job Solution.question: ৭৩) Head office of international court of Justice (ICJ) is located in ______.
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- নেদারল্যান্ডের হেগ শহরে অবস্থিত আন্তর্জাতিক ন্যায়বিচার আদালত (International Court of Justice-ICJ) জাতিসংঘের ছয়টি মূল অঙ্গসংস্থার একটি।
এটি ১৯৪৫ সালের জুন মাসে প্রতিষ্ঠিত হয় এবং কার্যক্রম শুরু করে ১৯৪৬ সালের এপ্রিলে।
মোট ১৫জন বিচারক নিয়ে ICJ গঠিত। বিচারকদের পদের মেয়াদ ৯ বছর করে। এদের মধ্য থেকে ৩ বছরের জন্যে একজন করে সভাপতি নির্বাচিত হয়।

(সূত্র: ICJ ওয়েবসাইট)

Bank Job Solution.question: ৭৮) The device used for measuring altitudes is -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- Altimeter, an instrument that measures the altitude of the land surface or any object such as an aeroplane.
The two main types are the pressure altimeter or aneroid barometer which approximates altitude above the sea level by measuring atmospheric pressure, and the radio altimeter,
which measures absolute altitude (distance above land or water) based on the time required for a radio wave signal to travel from an airplane, weather balloon, or a spacecraft to the ground and back.

Source: www.britannica.com

Bank Job Solution.question: ৮০) Point of sale (POS) machine is widely used by the -
Bank Job Solution.exp:
- It can be in a physical store, where POS terminals and systems are used to process card payments or a virtual sales point such as a computer or mobile electronic device.
- Whether installed on a cash register, PC, mobile device, or designated system, point of sale software allows merchants to quickly ring up items, calculate the total cost of the purchase, and securely process payment.
- Many merchants often use point of sale software exclusively to accept payments made by card, check, and even cash. However, modern-day POS systems are capable of so much more than payment processing. With the right setup, you can use your point of sale software to run your entire operation.
